lines.en: label tsubasaspring3:
scene clearnightsky
A familiar man opens the door to a familiar limousine and I crawl into the back next to Tsubasa.
lines.zh: 一个眼熟的男人拉开一辆眼熟的豪华轿车的车门,我爬进后座,坐在 Tsubasa 旁边。

lines.en: And while I’m no stranger to immediately departing the residence of a woman after ejaculating into her mouth, it’s not exactly common for the red carpet to be rolled out for my walk of shame.
lines.zh: 虽然在把精子射进一个女人嘴里后立刻离开她的住所,这种事我并不陌生,但让我的「耻辱之路」铺上红毯,可就不常见了。

lines.en: This, combined with the fact that I’m now quite literally trapped in the back of a moving vehicle with the closest thing I know to a super-villain, is a bit disconcerting to say the least.
lines.zh: 这一点,加上我此刻字面意义上被困在一辆行驶车辆的后座上、身边是我所知最接近超级反派的存在,怎么说都有点让人不安。

lines.en: I doubt this car will be driving off a cliff anytime soon, though. Not with precious cargo tucked safely into the backseat.
lines.zh: 不过我怀疑这辆车不会很快冲下悬崖。毕竟后排还稳稳地藏着重贵货物。

lines.en: But should that precious cargo need to lighten the load, I’m sure I’ll be the first to go.
lines.zh: 但若是那份贵重货物需要减重,我确信第一个被丢下去的就是我。

lines.en: I just hope these hands of stone will be enough to protect the wooden heart I hide behind my glass ribs once I’m forced to dance with the pavement at roughly fifty miles per hour.
lines.zh: 我只希望,当被迫以约每小时五十英里的速度与柏油路共舞时,我这双石手足以护住藏在玻璃肋骨后面的木心。

lines.en: : You’re not always this nervous in moving cars...are you, Akira? Can I assume that you’re once again seeing me as something far more scary than I truly am?
lines.zh: : 你在行驶的车里不总是这么紧张……对吧,Akira?我能否假定,你又把我看得比实际可怕得多了?

lines.en: scene tsubasalimo1x
: I’m always this nervous. So I’m sorry, but you won’t be able to take the credit for my mannerisms this time.
lines.zh: : 我一直这么紧张。所以抱歉,这次我的举止怪异,你抢不到功劳。

lines.en: : At least not all of it. You’re definitely adding to everything, though.
lines.zh: : 至少抢不到全部。不过你绝对在给一切都加码。

lines.en: : If it helps to dispel your worries, I can assure you Ishimoto is an excellent driver. He’s been chauffeuring me for many years now. You’re in the best of hands, I promise.
lines.zh: : 若这有助于打消你的疑虑,我可以向你保证,Ishimoto 是位出色的司机。他为我开车多年了。你正被最好的人护送着,我保证。

lines.en: : I believe you. The present can’t change the past, though.
lines.zh: : 我信。但现在改变不了过去。

lines.en: : It can change the way you perceive it.
lines.zh: : 但它能改变你感知过去的方式。

lines.en: : We all look differently when we’re hit by the light in certain ways.
lines.zh: : 当光以某种特定方式打在我们身上时,我们每个人的样子都会不同。

lines.en: : For example, you look much more handsome now than you did under that drab bar’s red glow. I suppose it helps that you’re not currently being fellated, though.
lines.zh: : 比如,你现在比在那家昏暗酒吧的红光下英俊多了。当然,我想这也帮了忙——你此刻没有正在被口交。

lines.en: : You literally watched the entire time.
lines.zh: : 你可是全程都在看。

lines.en: : I looked away on several occasions. Never for long. But I won’t sit here and let you blame me for being once more entranced by just how many women you’re willing to conquer.
lines.zh: : 我好几次移开了视线。都没移多久。但我不会坐在这儿任你指责——怪我再次被「你愿意征服的女人之多」迷住了。

lines.en: : Aren’t you the same girl who told me she’s used to watching women being sold off like cattle?
lines.zh: : 你不就是那个告诉我、她看惯了女人像牲口一样被卖掉的女孩吗?

lines.en: : I am. But I can’t say I have much experience with...farmers, so to speak.
lines.zh: : 我是。但要说……「农夫」,可以这么说,我没什么经验。

lines.en: : I wasn’t just conquering Sara. I genuinely care about her.
lines.zh: : 我不只是在征服 Sara。我是真心在乎她。

lines.en: : Do you genuinely care about me?
lines.zh: : 那你是真心在乎我吗?

lines.en: : Not really.
lines.zh: : 谈不上。

lines.en: scene tsubasalimo2x
: Hahah! Not yet, you mean.
lines.zh: : 哈哈!你是说「还谈不上」吧。

lines.en: scene tsubasalimo3x
: We simply just haven’t had enough time to get to know one another yet.
lines.zh: : 我们只是还没有足够的时间彼此了解罢了。

lines.en: : You’re the mystery here. I’m convinced you know practically all there is to know about me now that you have my full name.
lines.zh: : 这里的谜团是你。我确信,拿到了我的全名之后,关于我的一切你几乎已经无所不知。

lines.en: : Have I not already told you a great deal about myself? We’ve gone over my family’s history...how I came to be involved with the Tsukioka family...you even know where I went to high school.
lines.zh: : 我难道没告诉过你很多关于我自己的事吗?我们聊过我家的历史……我是如何与 Tsukioka 家产生瓜葛的……你甚至知道我高中在哪念的。

lines.en: : What more would you like to inquire about?
lines.zh: : 你还想探听什么?

lines.en: : What you want with me.
lines.zh: : 你想拿我做什么。

lines.en: : I’ve told you that on several occasions as well. You’re an...asset. But you’re also a friend.
lines.zh: : 那个我也说过好几次了。你是一项……资产。但你也是一位朋友。

lines.en: : It doesn’t always feel that way, though.
lines.zh: : 但感觉上并不总是如此。

lines.en: scene tsubasalimo4x
: Yes, well...
lines.zh: : 是,这个嘛……

lines.en: : I have to maintain a certain...distance, you see.
lines.zh: : 我必须保持一定的……距离,你明白。

lines.en: : If we become too friendly, someone may notice. And I have a reputation to uphold.
lines.zh: : 要是我们走得太近,会有人注意到。而我还有声誉要维持。

lines.en: : I believed that right up until you started stroking Sara’s hair while she was fellating me.
lines.zh: : 这话我信到你开始抚摸 Sara 的头发为止——当时她还在给我口交。

lines.en: : I’m speaking primarily about what goes on within the manor. You know that the vast majority of my time is spent within its grounds, Akira.
lines.zh: : 我说的主要是在公馆之内发生的事。你知道,我的绝大部分时间都消磨在它的围墙之内,Akira。

lines.en: : The world outside of my walls is hardly even real as far as I’m concerned.
lines.zh: : 就我而言,墙外的世界几乎算不上真实。

lines.en: : Yeah, I kind of figured that’s why you showed no qualms when it came to subtly belittling Sara in her own business.
lines.zh: : 是啊,我多少猜到了——所以你在 Sara 自己的店里含蓄贬低她时,才会毫无顾忌。

lines.en: scene tsubasalimo5x
: You really do care about her, don’t you? You seem awfully offended by some of my dialogue choices tonight.
lines.zh: : 你真的在乎她,对吧?我今晚的某些台词,似乎让你相当恼火。

lines.en: : She has feelings, Tsubasa.
lines.zh: : 她有感情,Tsubasa。

lines.en: : And you think a few measly jabs at her status put her in greater jeopardy than the fact that you’re on the brink of leading two teenage girls into a debauched life of sex disguised as love?
lines.zh: : 你觉得几句微不足道的、针对她身份的挖苦,会比「你即将把两个少女领入以爱为名的放荡性生活」更让她身处险境?

lines.en: : If it is only two, of course. You could be involved with your entire class for all I know.
lines.zh: : 当然,如果只有两个的话。说不定你和你全班都有一腿呢,谁知道。

lines.en: : I imagine you already would know.
lines.zh: : 我猜你应该已经知道。

lines.en: : Perhaps I do and I’m just keeping it a secret until I encounter you with them next. Regardless, you stand to hurt her far more than I ever could.
lines.zh: : 也许我知道,只是想保密到下次撞见你和她她们在一起。无论如何,你能伤她的程度,远超我之所及。

lines.en: : So maybe it would be wise to not treat me like the bad guy when you’re the one traipsing all over Kumon-mi, sowing seeds of destruction in every single place you roam.
lines.zh: : 所以,明明是你自己在 Kumon-mi 到处游荡、在踏足的每一处播撒毁灭的种子,或许就不该把我当坏人对待。

lines.en: : What’s wrong, Aki-kun? Cat got your tongue?
lines.zh: : 怎么了,Aki 君?舌头被猫叼走了?

lines.en: : Never call me that again. Do you understand?
lines.zh: : 再也不许那么叫我。明白吗?

lines.en: : No. Could you say it a little louder, please? Maybe grab my shoulders and shake me around a bit?
lines.zh: : 不。能请你再大声说一遍吗?或者抓住我的肩膀摇晃几下?

lines.en: : And have your driver pull over and beat me to death? Pass. Just...don’t call me that. Please.
lines.zh: : 然后让你司机靠边停车把我打死?不了。只是……别那么叫我。拜托。

lines.en: scene tsubasalimo1x
: You really are interesting, Akira. You remind me a lot of an old friend when you get passionate like that.
lines.zh: : 你真有意思,Akira。你像那样激动起来的时候,特别像一位故人。

lines.en: : It’s not passion. It’s anger and resentment and fear and sadness and-
lines.zh: : 那不是激情。那是愤怒、怨恨、恐惧、悲伤,还有——

lines.en: : And all of those things can combine to form passion under the right circumstances. It’s like I said before. Everything changes with the light. Neither you nor I are exceptions to that.
lines.zh: : 而在合适的环境下,这一切融合在一起,就成了激情。就像我之前说的。一切随光而变。你我皆非例外。

lines.en: Tsubasa reaches forward, tracing circles around my knee with the tip of her index finger. But there doesn’t seem to be any...intent to it.
lines.zh: Tsubasa 探过身来,用食指尖绕着我的膝盖画圈。但那似乎没有任何……意图。

lines.en: In fact, I’m not even sure if she’s aware she’s doing it. I imagine she is as it’s hard for me to think anything she does isn’t cleverly calculated, but still.
lines.zh: 实际上,我甚至不确定她是否意识到自己在这么做。我想她应该意识到了——毕竟在我看来,她做的任何事都难以说不是精打细算。但仍然。

lines.en: It makes me comfortable and scared at the same time. But I can’t figure out how to make those things combine. Which makes what she said just seconds ago even harder to understand.
lines.zh: 这让我同时感到安心和害怕。可我搞不清如何让这两者合而为一。这让她几秒前说的话,更难理解了。

lines.en: : Tsubasa...what do you think you’d be doing right now if you never met me?
lines.zh: : Tsubasa……你觉得,如果从没遇见我,你现在会在做什么?

lines.en: : Why, sipping some of the poorest wine that’s ever touched my tongue, of course.
lines.zh: : 哎呀,当然是啜饮着有生以来沾过我舌尖的最劣质的红酒。

lines.en: : Not just tonight, but...in general.
lines.zh: : 不只是今晚,而是……总体而言。

lines.en: : Both of your daughters were struggling to learn how the “outside world” functioned or whatever. And you didn’t have anyone’s backstory to start prying open as your newest hobby.
lines.zh: : 你的两个女儿当时都在艰难学习「外面的世界」如何运作之类的。而你也没有谁的身世可以撬开,当作你最新的爱好。

lines.en: : If we never crossed paths at that onsen however many years ago it was, everything would be different right now.
lines.zh: : 如果当年不知多少年前,我们没有在那家温泉相遇,现在的一切都会不同。

lines.en: scene tsubasalimo6x
: Is that really what you believe?
lines.zh: : 你真这么认为?

lines.en: : I mean...yeah. That was the catalyst that ultimately brought Touka into my life. And without Touka, we’d have no reason to see each other at all.
lines.zh: : 我是说……对。那正是最终把 Touka 带进我人生的催化剂。而没有 Touka,我们根本没有任何见面的理由。

lines.en: : I suppose we wouldn’t, would we?
lines.zh: : 我想是的,不是吗?

lines.en: : But I’m not sure it would even matter, if you’d like my honest opinion.
lines.zh: : 但我不确定那是否真的重要——如果你想听我的实话。

lines.en: : Fate has a funny way of forcing things together. And I truly believe that our paths were meant to cross one way or the other.
lines.zh: : 命运撮合万物的方式总是很滑稽。而我真心相信,我们的道路命中注定会以这样或那样的方式交汇。

lines.en: : And why is that? Because you’re not important to me and I’m not important to you. What would fate have to do with any of this?
lines.zh: : 为什么?因为你对我不重要,我对你也不重要。这和命运有什么关系?

lines.en: : ...Tsubasa?
lines.zh: : ……Tsubasa?

lines.en: : Forgive me, Akira. I’ve said too much. So I’m going to go ahead and drop this subject now.
lines.zh: : 原谅我,Akira。我说得太多了。所以我现在要把这个话题搁下。

lines.en: : ...What?
scene tsubasalimo7x
: But as a consolation prize, I’ll allow you to choose our next conversation topic.
lines.zh: : 但作为安慰奖,我允许你来选我们下一个话题。

lines.en: : I’d like to talk more about fate please.
lines.zh: : 我想多聊聊命运,拜托。

lines.en: : Ha ha. Very funny. But no. I was thinking something more...fun. Personal, even.
lines.zh: : 哈哈。真好笑。但不。我在想更有……趣味的东西。甚至,私人一点。

lines.en: : Sure. But be aware that you’ll have to do all of the heavy lifting since I’m not good at talking about that kind of stuff.
lines.zh: : 行。但你要知道,苦活得你全包——因为我不擅长聊那种话题。

lines.en: : That’s fine. I probably know it all already anyway.
lines.zh: : 没关系。反正那些我大概早就知道了。

lines.en: : Ha ha. Very funny.
lines.zh: : 哈哈。真好笑。

lines.en: scene tsubasalimo5x
: Any suggestions? Things you’ve been dying to know more about? My three sizes? My...ideal partner?
lines.zh: : 有什么建议吗?你一直求知若渴的事?我的三围?我的……理想伴侣?

lines.en: : Careful, Tsubasa. Ishimoto might relay anything you say about your ideal partner to your husband.
lines.zh: : 小心,Tsubasa。你对理想伴侣说的话,Ishimoto 可能会转达给你的丈夫。

lines.en: scene tsubasalimo8x
: Ishimoto will do nothing of the sort as he understands he’d be castrated for it. Isn’t that correct, Ishimoto?
lines.zh: : Ishimoto 不会做那种事——他清楚那样做的下场是被阉割。对吧,Ishimoto?

lines.en: : Of course, madam. Your word is law.
lines.zh: : 当然,夫人。您的话就是法律。

lines.en: : Ahh, how I love being rich.
lines.zh: : 啊,有钱真好。

lines.en: : Well, at the risk of finding out your ideal partner would be anything or anyone other than me, how about this-
lines.zh: : 好,冒着发现你的理想伴侣是我以外的任何东西或任何人的风险,不如这样——

lines.en: scene tsubasalimo9x
: What’s the craziest thing you’ve ever done?
lines.zh: : 你做过的最疯狂的事是什么?

lines.en: : The craziest thing I’ve ever done?
lines.zh: : 我做过的最疯狂的事?

lines.en: : I suppose it would have to be giving you my youngest daughter’s phone number. That could have gone south in many ways. But you’ve yet to disappoint me in response, Akira. I’m proud.
lines.zh: : 我想,非把小女儿的电话号码给你莫属。那件事本可能以许多方式翻车。但你的回应至今没有让我失望,Akira。我很骄傲。

lines.en: : I meant sexually.
lines.zh: : 我说的是性方面的。

lines.en: : Sexually?
lines.zh: : 性方面?

lines.en: : If you’re going to encroach on my sex life and watch my friends go down on me, the least you can do is give me something to hold over you as well.
lines.zh: : 既然你要侵入我的性生活,还要看我的朋友给我口,你至少也该给我留下点什么能拿捏你的东西吧。

lines.en: : I don’t intend to hold anything over you, Akira. I was merely enjoying a little show. Besides, isn’t it rather daring to ask a woman of my caliber about her sexual history?
lines.zh: : 我可没打算拿捏你什么,Akira。我只是在欣赏一场小表演。再说,向我这种水准的女人打听性史,是不是相当大胆?

lines.en: : You said I could choose. This is what I’m choosing. It’s either this or we go back to talking about fate and how you’re, once again, weirdly hiding seemingly relevant information from me.
lines.zh: : 你说了让我选。这就是我选的。要么回答这个,要么我们回头聊命运——聊你怎么又一次、怪异地把看似相关的信息瞒着我。

lines.en: scene tsubasalimo10x
: The craziest thing I’ve ever done?
lines.zh: : 我做过的最疯狂的事?

lines.en: : Has there even been anything like that?
lines.zh: : 到底有没有那种事?

lines.en: : I hope. A life of nothing but consensual sex in the missionary position with your husband sounds extremely boring and unfulfilling.
lines.zh: : 我希望有。一生只有和丈夫在传教士位上两情相悦的性爱,听起来极其无聊、毫无成就感。

lines.en: : And I can confirm that it is.
lines.zh: : 而我可以证实,确实如此。

lines.en: scene tsubasalimo11x
: Though, there was that one time when I had intercourse with four members of the massage staff at once.
lines.zh: : 不过,有那么一次,我和四位按摩师同时性交来着。

lines.en: scene tsubasalimo10x
: Sorry. Did I hear that correctly just now?
lines.zh: : 抱歉。我刚才听对了吗?

lines.en: scene tsubasalimo9x
: I’m not sure. What did you hear?
lines.zh: : 我不确定。你听到了什么?

lines.en: : That you had sex with four guys at once?
lines.zh: : 你和四个男人同时做爱?

lines.en: : Oh, yes. The night before I was married. It’s a family tradition.
lines.zh: : 哦,对。我婚前那晚。这是家族传统。

lines.en: : To get fucked by four guys at once the night before your wedding???
lines.zh: : 婚礼前夜被四个男人同时操???

lines.en: : Why do you sound so perplexed by this extremely common ritual?
lines.zh: : 你为什么对这项极其常见的仪式如此困惑?

lines.en: : Because that’s not a common ritual at all?? And it paints you in a completely different light now that I know you’re getting gang-banged by masseurs.
lines.zh: : 因为这根本不是什么常见仪式??而且知道你会被按摩师们轮暴之后,你在我眼里的形象彻底变了。

lines.en: : Well, how many men do lower and middle class women typically bed before the night of their wedding?
lines.zh: : 那么,中下层女性的婚前之夜,通常和几个男人上过床?

lines.en: : Probably none? Maybe their fiancée?
lines.zh: : 大概没有?顶多未婚夫?

lines.en: : Well, that sounds rather boring too, doesn’t it?
lines.zh: : 嗯,那听起来也相当无聊,不是吗?

lines.en: scene tsubasalimo12x
: Besides, I’m not being gang-banged by anyone. At least not on a consistent basis. That was decades ago.
lines.zh: : 再说,我没有被任何人轮暴。至少不是常态。那是几十年前的事了。

lines.en: : And while there’s still a full staff of therapists on call at Tsukioka Manor, none of them would dare touch me in such a way even if I commanded them to. Trust me, I’ve tried.
lines.zh: : 而且,尽管 Tsukioka 公馆仍备着整支随叫随到的理疗师团队,但即使我下令,也没人敢那样碰我。相信我,我试过。

lines.en: : Then how are you-
lines.zh: : 那你现在怎么——

lines.en: scene tsubasalimo13x
: I’m not. It’s as simple as that.
lines.zh: : 我没有。就这么简单。

lines.en: : I have little time for such pleasures anymore in the first place. So please forgive me if I...crossed any lines tonight.
lines.zh: : 首先,如今我几乎没有时间享受那种乐子。所以如果我今晚……越了什么界,还请原谅。

lines.en: : It was nice living vicariously through someone else for a change. I don’t often want to do that.
lines.zh: : 换个方式,借他人的人生间接活一回,感觉不错。我不常想这么做。

lines.en: if chikalust25 == True:
: I’ll admit that watching you dominate Chika was far more pleasurable, though. The taboo factor added a layer of depravity that, while initially shameful, was quite invigorating in hindsight.
lines.zh: : 不过我承认,看你支配 Chika 要愉快得多。禁忌成分添上了一层堕落,虽然起初令人羞耻,回想起来却相当提神。

lines.en: : So you and your husband just...
lines.zh: : 所以你和你丈夫就……

lines.en: scene tsubasalimo14x
: I see you more than him at this point. He and I don’t even sleep in the same room anymore.
lines.zh: : 到如今,我见你比见他多。我和他甚至已经不同房睡了。

lines.en: : Why not?
lines.zh: : 为什么?

lines.en: : That’s just the way things worked out, I suppose.
lines.zh: : 我想,事情就走到了那一步。

lines.en: : And apart from him and the massage staff, I barely have any experience with anyone at all.
lines.zh: : 而除了他和按摩团队之外,我几乎没有任何与别人相关的经验。

lines.en: scene tsubasalimo15x
: Though, there was that one time when my friends and I ran off to the urban district and I had intercourse with four men I’d met at a party.
lines.zh: : 不过,有那么一次,我和朋友们溜去市区,和派对上认识的四个男人性交来着。

lines.en: scene tsubasalimo16x
: Jesus Christ, Tsubasa.
lines.zh: : 我的老天,Tsubasa。

lines.en: : No, I don’t think he was there. I may be old, but I’m not that old.
lines.zh: : 不,我想他不在场。我也许老了,但没那么老。

lines.en: : Why is it always four?
lines.zh: : 为什么总是四个?

lines.en: : Because once you start adding more than that, no one knows what to do.
lines.zh: : 因为一旦超过四个,就没人知道该干什么了。

lines.en: : So what I’m learning is you have a ton of experience and you’re just once again tricking me into looking at you in a certain light.
lines.zh: : 所以我学到的是:你经验丰富得很,而你又一次在骗我用某种眼光看你。

lines.en: : Perhaps. But by that logic, wouldn’t you say it’s possible neither of those...what do you call them — orgies — happened at all, is it not?
lines.zh: : 也许。但照这个逻辑,你会不会说,那两场……你们怎么称呼来着——群交——根本都没发生过,难道不是?

lines.en: : I...guess? But why would you want me to think you’re experienced when you’re not?
lines.zh: : 我……猜是?可如果你没有经验,为什么想让我以为你有?

lines.en: scene tsubasalimo3x
: Why indeed?
lines.zh: : 为什么呢?

lines.en: : I really hate when you answer questions by just...questioning the question. It’s impossible to learn anything that way.
lines.zh: : 我真讨厌你用……反问来回答问题。那样什么也学不到。

lines.en: : That’s the point, Akira.
lines.zh: : 目的正在于此,Akira。

lines.en: : Madam, we’ll be arriving at Master Arakawa’s residence in approximately one minute. If you have yet to finish conversing, I can circle the area or-
lines.zh: : 夫人,大约一分钟后我们将抵达 Arakawa 大师的住处。若二位尚未谈完,我可以绕行,或者——

lines.en: : No, you may proceed to the destination. Master Arakawa and I are done here.
lines.zh: : 不必,直接前往目的地。Arakawa 大师和我已经谈完了。

lines.en: : We are? Because it sounded like things were finally getting good. I’m actually not intimidated for once.
lines.zh: : 谈完了?听起来事情终于进入佳境了啊。我难得一次没有被吓住。

lines.en: : Are you coming onto me, Akira?
lines.zh: : 你在向我献殷勤吗,Akira?

lines.en: Her fingers stops tracing circles on my knee. It slides further up my leg instead.
lines.zh: 她画圈的手指停了下来。转而顺着我的腿向上滑。

lines.en: : I’m a married woman, you know...and based on the girls I’ve seen you with, I think it’s safe to say I’m...not your type.
lines.zh: : 我可是有夫之妇,你知道……而根据我见过的那些和你在一起的女孩,我敢说我……不是你的型。

lines.en: I grab her wrist. She doesn’t flinch.
lines.zh: 我抓住她的手腕。她没有退缩。

lines.en: : I’m not afraid of you, Tsubasa.
lines.zh: : 我不怕你,Tsubasa。

lines.en: : Not anymore, you’re not...
lines.zh: : 现在是不怕了……

lines.en: : But that’s because I spoon-fed you certain details that shattered the illusion.
lines.zh: : 但那是因为,我亲手喂给了你某些细节,击碎了那层幻象。

lines.en: : That...wait, what?
lines.zh: : 那……等等,什么?

lines.en: : It’s rather funny how quickly a powerful woman can be seen as weak once certain...details come out.
lines.zh: : 一旦某些……细节流出,一位有权势的女人能多快被看成弱者,还挺滑稽的。

lines.en: : All it took for you to change the way you look at me was a little bit of lust and some seductive whispers — tall tales of times that I’ve been vulnerable.
lines.zh: : 要改变你看我的眼光,只需要一点点欲望,和几句蛊惑的低语——一些关于我曾被脆弱吞噬的荒诞故事。

lines.en: : Why is it that being swallowed up by the pleasures of the flesh makes you seem stronger — but me seem weak?
lines.zh: : 为什么被肉体欢愉吞没,让你显得更强——却让我显得弱?

lines.en: : I’m as scary as I’ve always been. You’re just easy to manipulate.
lines.zh: : 我一直和从前一样可怕。只是你容易操纵。

lines.en: : Uhh...so, wait. None of that ever happened? I’m confused.
lines.zh: : 呃……所以,等等。那些事都没发生过?我糊涂了。

lines.en: : It all changes with the light, Akira.
lines.zh: : 一切都随光而变,Akira。

lines.en: scene black
: Sometimes, the things you see aren’t really there.
lines.zh: : 有时候,你看见的东西并不真的存在。

lines.en: : And other times, there’s something you can’t help but miss.
lines.zh: : 而另一些时候,有些东西你难免错过。

lines.en: : Madam, we’ve arrived.
lines.zh: : 夫人,我们到了。

lines.en: : Maybe it’s because you’re distracted...maybe you just don’t want to see it...
lines.zh: : 也许是因为你分心了……也许你只是不想看见……

lines.en: : But you can never know what’s real until you experience it.
lines.zh: : 但不亲自体验,你永远无法知道什么是真实。

lines.en: She swats my hand away and leans back in her seat.
lines.zh: 她拍开我的手,靠回座椅。

lines.en: : And some things are harder to experience than they look.
lines.zh: : 而有些事,体验起来比看起来难得多。

lines.en: The driver opens my door and steps to the side.
lines.zh: 司机打开我的车门,退到一旁。

lines.en: : Goodnight, Akira.
lines.zh: : 晚安,Akira。

lines.en: : It’s been a...pleasure.
lines.zh: : 真是一段……乐事。

lines.en: She winks at me once more.
lines.zh: 她又一次朝我眨眼。

lines.en: The door to the limo closes.
lines.zh: 豪华轿车的车门关上了。

lines.en: scene bedroom_night
And I go back to my room.
lines.zh: 而我回到自己的房间。

lines.en: scene black
I don’t think I’ll ever understand her.
lines.zh: 我想我永远无法理解她。

lines.en: $ tsubasaspring3 = True
$ tsubasa_love += 1
Tsubasa’s affection has increased to [tsubasa_love]!
lines.zh: Tsubasa 的好感度提升到了 [tsubasa_love]!
